what: DERIVATION, independent attempt 1 of 4: The sphere formation law forgets its initial plane on the infinite lattice. Block 26 (PR #8170): executed, not proved: starting from an aligned plane the magnetization of the sphere formation law decays with no plateau for beta = 3..24 (exponents at or above gamma(beta) = c_0 A(3 beta)/(3 beta), c_0 = 3 sqrt 3/(4 pi)); the equilibrium twist argument fails in level time (recorded there under N1). Block 27 (PR #8171) proves uniqueness only for beta < 1/sqrt 3. TASK: prove that for every beta the law reached from an aligned plane has m_t -> 0 on the infinite plane (or for beta in an explicit larger range), or find the obstruction. Routes: (i) a relative-entropy argument in path space: compare the path measure with its image under a slowly varying rotation field theta(x, t); the cost per level is a Dirichlet form of the plane walk P and the benefit is the rotation of the mean; the two-dimensional recurrence of P is what should make the cost vanish; (ii) a comparison with the linear model using the monotonicity of A(kappa)/kappa (block 27's sign lemma); (iii) an O(3)-invariance plus ergodicity argument for the level automaton. State exactly which step fails if the route fails. DELIVERABLE, in your unit worktree on ai/probes: probes/work/derive/plane-memory-loss/<your worker name>/ATTEMPT.md and check.py. ATTEMPT.md: (1) the exact statement you attempt; (2) numbered steps, each marked PROVED (argument given in full), CHECKED (a finite fact check.py verifies exactly) or ASSUMED; (3) if the route fails, the FIRST step that fails and why: a precise no-go for a route is a result; (4) what would finish it. check.py: exact arithmetic (fractions, integers, sympy) for every finite claim; it prints `SUMMARY: PROVED ...`, `SUMMARY: COUNTEREXAMPLE ...`, `SUMMARY: PARTIAL <what is new and exact>` or `SUMMARY: ROUTE FAILS AT <step>`, and a line `HIT: <the claim>` ONLY when you claim a proof, a counterexample, or a new exact partial result others can build on; a HIT is handed to a worker of another model family to referee line by line, so write for a hostile reader. Rules: definitions come from the notes on the PR branches named above (git fetch origin <branch>; git show origin/<branch>:<note>; find them with gh pr view <n> --json files,headRefName); any outside theorem you use must be re-proved at the scope you use it or listed under ASSUMED; no status words (proved theorems are promoted by the supervisor after the referee). Have your own plan BEFORE reading the prior attempts printed at claim time; then either build on a refereed partial result or take a different route. Run: python3 probes/run_probe.py <task> --worker <name> --model <model> --review "..." --extra "python3 probes/work/derive/plane-memory-loss/<name>/check.py"
